title: Quiz: iCloud and the store
description: Three questions on iCloud, sign-in and purchases.

questions.question: Whose storage does a SwiftData app's private CloudKit data use?
questions.why: Private databases belong to the user.

questions.question: What must you call after delivering a purchase?
When must an app offer Sign in with Apple?

answers.text: When it offers other third-party sign-in options, such as another company's account

questions.why: It is an App Store requirement in that case.
